messages:
maria_support: Ethan from Acme sent a ticket — embeddings API is throwing a dimension mismatch and severe latency when they send batched requests from eu-west-1. He says it started after a weekend traffic spike. Posting logs and repro below. Can eng-runtime take a look? :eyes:

ethan_customer: repro steps I ran (minimal):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \\n  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY\" \\n  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\n  -d '{\"model\":\"open-embed-1536\", \"inputs\":[\"a\",\"b\",\"c\"], \"region\":\"eu-west-1\", \"batch_size\":64}'
```
Response: `400 Bad Request` with body `\{\"error\":\"dimension_mismatch: expected 1536 got 1530\"\}` and then some requests time out (504). Latency spikes to 2-8s for some calls.

maria_support: Adding logs from our edge traces — looks like routing is bouncing to us-central when eu-west pool is busy: 
```
[2026-06-05T08:12:33Z] req_id=abc123 route=eu-west-1 -> spillover(us-central-1) pool=embeddings-eu status=queue
[2026-06-05T08:12:34Z] req_id=abc124 model=open-embed-1536 selected_variant=open-embed-1536-quant pool_cold_start=true
[2026-06-05T08:12:36Z] req_id=abc124 error=dimension_mismatch expected=1536 actual=1530
```
Feels like spillover + cold-start returned a different model variant with a different output dim?

jamie_oncall: I'm on it. First guess: model variant mismatch + fallback to a different family (maybe a 1530-dim experimental model). Also batching=64 may push the runtime into an alternate code path. Pulling routing logs and variant mapping now.

devin_eng_runtime: Can you paste the exact model id used by the customer (as sent to the API) and the model catalog entry we map that id to? If it spilled to us-central we may have an older variant deployment. Also what are the customer keys/tenant id? I'll check model catalog & routing policy.

maria_support: Model id in the curl above is `open-embed-1536` (customer copy-pasted from docs). Customer tenant: acct-acme-77 (I DM'd the API key fingerprint).

devin_eng_runtime: Found it. Our eu-west pool had autoscaled down overnight to 0 active GPUs (low baseline) and we have a spillover policy that routes to any compatible region when capacity is insufficient. Unfortunately, us-central deployed `open-embed-1536-v2` which was accidentally packaged with an upstream training artifact that emits 1530-dim vectors. The model mapping should have prevented this but a deploy tag mismatch slipped by.

sara_prodops: Oof. Steps I'd recommend now:
1) Temporarily pin acct-acme-77 to `region=us-central-1` only if they explicitly asked for us-central (they didn't) — not ideal. Better:
2) Block auto-spillover for embeddings for the customer until we fix variant mapping (prevent cross-region variant surprises).
3) Hotfix: rollback `open-embed-1536-v2` in us-central to v1 build that produces 1536 dims.
4) Increase eu-west min-replicas for embeddings pools to avoid cold starts for high-volume customers.

jamie_oncall: Agreed. I'll add a temporary rate limit/hold on spillover for that tenant. @devin_eng_runtime can you roll back the v2 variant in us-central? I can also flip a route policy flag to prefer same-region exact-variant matching.

devin_eng_runtime: Rolling back v2 now. Command I'm running: 
```
# rollback command (internal)
redwood deploy rollback --model open-embed-1536-v2 --region us-central-1 --to-tag v1
```
Will monitor for errors.

deploy-bot: Deploy rollback started for open-embed-1536-v2 -> v1 in us-central-1 by devin_eng_runtime at 2026-06-05T08:22:12Z.

incident-bot: Alert muted for acct-acme-77 spillover; spillover hold applied for embeddings for 1h.

maria_support: Ethan, we applied a temporary spillover hold and rolled back the variant in us-central. Could you try your repro again? Also please try lowering batch_size to 16 as a temporary mitigation.

ethan_customer: re-running now. With batch_size=16: latency back to ~120-250ms and no dimension error. With batch_size=64: still seeing occasional 400s but MUCH less. Thanks for the fast turnaround.

devin_eng_runtime: Follow-ups I will do before closing:
- Add a guard in the router to require exact model-dim match before allowing cross-region fallback.
- Add a model-catalog invariant check in deploy pipeline so variant packaging mismatch fails deploy.
- Add telemetry alert for dim-mismatch errors per-model that triggers early.
- Update autoscale min for eu-west embeddings pool from 0 -> 1 for customers with >100 reqs/min.

sara_prodops: I'll create a postmortem doc and propose an SLA change for critical-embeddings (min replicas). Also will add a runbook entry: if customer sees dimension_mismatch, check for cross-region fallback and blocked spillover.

jamie_oncall: One small note: batching=64 is pushing higher memory allocs and increases probability of cold-start variant selection path; we should recommend default batch_size=16 in SDK plus a warning if batch_size>32 for embeddings in region with <2 replicas. I'll file a docs PR.

maria_support: Customer confirmed stable for now. Ethan, please reopen if anything else pops up. Thanks everyone for the quick help :thumbsup:

ethan_customer: thanks all. Appreciate the quick fix. I'll wait for the postmortem and any recommended SDK changes.

maria_support: Action items created:
- ENG-RUNTIME: enforce exact-dim requirement on cross-region fallbacks (task #ENG-4012)
- ENG-RELEASES: add model-catalog packaging check (task #ENG-4013)
- PROD-OPS: raise eu-west min-replicas (task #OPS-219)
- DOCS: default batch_size guidance + warning (task #DX-78)

maria_support: Closing thread — will attach postmortem link when Sara posts it. :white_check_mark:
